what: H2 touchdown-time distributions on select (plan Phase 7 item 3): plotted only, never scored
caption: Simulated: PyBullet physics; P8 success criteria and outcome classes. Not a frozen list: splits/select.parquet (150 P8 tune-pool episodes, 50 per sea state).
Model scale, lambda = 1/25: times x5 for full scale.

bc_mix and dp_mix are distilled from T_mix (P8 ppo s0 + gated, balanced per sea state); dp_mix at Ta = 8, K = 10. Row 1 and the histograms pool seeds 0-2; rows 2-3 show each seed. Student rows are the select rows of each seed's checkpoint selected on these same episodes (in-sample).

W1 and the gap fraction (touchdowns between the ppo half's p90 and the gated half's p10, shaded; post hoc) are descriptive and unscored, on select, without an interval. The scored H2 is id SS4 in Phase 8, seeds pooled as P3-D1 states.
dp's failures at Ta = 8 are lateral (off_pad, Phase 6) and do not depend on sea state; do not read them as multimodality effects without checking.
P8's teacher saw the tune realizations in P8's own tuning; its select rows may read high.
units: time_to_touchdown_s: seconds, model scale (lambda = 1/25); x5 for full scale
statistics: quantiles: P8 quantile_linear (type 7) over touched-down episodes; W1: exact 1-D empirical Wasserstein-1 (ila.eval.metrics.wasserstein_1) between a group's touched-down times (seeds pooled, or one seed) and the T_mix reference's in the same cell; gap fraction: share of touched-down times strictly between the reference's faster half's p90 and slower half's p10 in the same cell (post hoc, added 2026-11-03 after the per-seed p50s were seen); all descriptive, no interval, no test. H2 (Phase 8) pools seeds as P3-D1 states; the per-seed view is for the plot only
